title: Is Intrinsic Vowel Duration Bio-Mechanical or More? Preliminary Results from Northwestern Italian / coretta2018itaegg
task: read carrier sentences containing CVCo target words
token_or_recording_size: ita_egg: 3268 observations x 52 variables; formants: 3053 observations x 38 variables
annotation_target: sentence/word/V1/C2/V2/voicing/release landmarks; vowel duration; VOT; voicing durations; F0; F1-F3 across five vowel windows; speech rate
manual_scope: SPPAS alignment output manually corrected by the author in Praat; FastTrack formant measurements manually checked and maximum-frequency settings adjusted where necessary
decision_reason: Primary controlled Italian production data with publicly released observation tables, exhaustive manual correction of the relevant temporal alignment, and manually checked formant tracking.
evidence_summary: Paper reports 19 Northwestern Italian speakers reading target sentences. SPPAS output was manually corrected in Praat using vowel-formant criteria; FastTrack formants were manually checked. The CC-BY-4.0 package exposes ita_egg (3268 x 52) and formants (3053 x 38), including explicit C1/V1/C2/V2 context, temporal landmarks, duration/VOT/voicing, F0 and F1-F3 at five successive 20% vowel windows.
